notes.title: New Game Witches Brew Is Available NOW!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello there, alchemists and witches! [/h3]

We bring you enchanting news today: our newest game, Witches Brew, has just been released on Steam! Head on over to the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1008230/Witches_Brew/]Steam Page [/url][/b]and get the game now! 


Witches Brew is the story of Selene, a coven witch traveling from the big city in search of adventure!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/22700973/7ace7e17e3e767bc52b6aaa2b4d3424a8c81bff8.png[/img]
[i]Get ready to dominate potion making and the sexiest girls~[/i]
[hr][/hr]
Gorgeous girls, an enchanting world full of magic and an amazing story all await you! Head on ahead to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1008230/Witches_Brew/]The Steam Page[/url][/b] and get the game right now!

I know you’re not a witch yourself, but you still encountered such a magical opportunity. You’re talented.


Dharker Studios

notes.title: Negligee: Love Stories
notes.content:
We are now working on a prequel for Negligee, it will be set a short time before the start of the first game and will include multiple stories from the points of view of the different characters that appeared in this game.

Checkout some basics on the game on our Store page:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/467680/Negligee_Stories/

[h1]Kickstarter Campaign Live[/h1]

In addition the game is currently live on kickstarter, seeking funding to expand the game with more stories and content, the kickstarter has been live for just a couple of hours and has already achieved it's primary goal.

With a variety of content still to be funded and plenty of time left before the campaign ends there is every reason to hope this game will be funded to an amazing level to grant amazing content for our players.

Checkout the campaign now for more details:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dharkerfigurine/negligee

The kickstarter campaign offers the chance to join the games beta testing, get additional content and exclusive kickstarter only physical rewards as well.
